gen-gf-pattaya-fs-literata: Pattaya packs its letters tight, like rivets in a steel seam, with terminals that nearly touch and a measured thick-thin ratio. Literata, a text serif, opens its curves wide in reply.
gen-gf-pavanam-fs-literata: Tight and crescent-cut, Pavanam keeps letter gaps narrower than a pen nib. It handles the low-key, hairline-light headline work, while Literata, with sturdy thin lines beside heavier stems, carries the bookish reading.
gen-gf-paytone-one-fs-literata: Literata reads bookish and sophisticated, its curves leaving wide mouths. Paytone One, stretched out with spacious tracking and the s squeezed nearly shut, gives the pair its sharpest quality: a tight, rounded headline against open, lightly modulated text.
gen-gf-peddana-fs-bespoke-sans: Peddana fits its letters closely and shifts gently from thick to thin, giving it a bookish, editorial air. Bespoke Sans stays sharp, leaving generous space where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-peralta-fs-bespoke-sans: Dignified and widely tracked, Peralta flickers with a mild shimmer of weight changes across each word. And Bespoke Sans, sharp and refined with generous gaps at its curve ends, gives that serif a crisp, low-contrast counterpart.
gen-gf-petrona-fs-bespoke-sans: Worn-stamp restraint defines Petrona, whose curves open outward instead of curling in, with a modest stem-to-hairline ratio. Its authority leads the page, while Bespoke Sans stays sharp and refined below.
gen-gf-philosopher-fs-literata: Approachable and open-ended, Philosopher lets its curves breathe with only a soft shift in thickness. But Literata, a text serif, brings sturdier hairlines and heavier stems, so heading is gentle and body more bookish.
gen-gf-platypi-fs-bespoke-sans: Platypi leads with thick strokes, heavier verticals like a tilted nib leaves, that guide the eye without taking over. Bespoke Sans follows as a plain sans, sharp and refined, with generous room around its curves.
gen-gf-playfair-fs-bespoke-sans: Classic in manner, Playfair swells its curves into heavy ink beside hairline strokes, with terminals cut open so counters flow outward. And Bespoke Sans, sharp and low in contrast, would keep a long page moving smoothly.
gen-gf-playfair-display-sc-fs-bespoke-sa: Playfair Display SC loosely tracks its letters, swelling curves like poured tar into threadlike ends. Bespoke Sans, a plain sans with generous space at its curve ends, makes the pair's strongest quality its dignified, sharp contrast.
